maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from asset management fees on alternative investment programs, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are institutions, family offices and individuals paying management and incentive fees; pension funds are not primarily government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by raising client assets and launching strategies; acquisitions are only occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Investors can reallocate to other alternative managers; customized mandates and illiquid fund lockups add only moderate friction.

notes: Mission-critical is a borderline call because of illiquid fund lockups.
